review.reviewer: Codex implementation owner; prospective design self-review
review.decision: Review the existing regressions against the scoped desktop notification lifecycle
review.notes: Follow-up for the installed Mac duplicate HQ alerts. Preserve durable scheduling, real urgency, read-only verification and recovery handling. Use only isolated synthetic fixtures and fake desktop output.

cases.description: A lower-priority newcomer cannot evict a full queue of decisions
cases.setup: Fill 200 synthetic decision-priority entries with a fake clock. Capture the exact queued names and occurrence of pressure.
cases.action: Enqueue a standing warning, then an equally ranked new decision.
cases.expected: The warning is explicitly rejected and all prior decision entries survive. An equal-priority new entry may replace the oldest of its rank with a truthful eviction audit. Both pressure outcomes have distinct stages.

cases.description: Wake health reports independently and only clears after recovery evidence
cases.setup: Use isolated HOME and a fake clock with an old down marker, exact staged conflict, no HQ or healthy pane states, and a later independently confirmed delivery.
cases.action: Evaluate duplicate and changed wake incidents, an independently confirmed workspace blocker, and recovery.
cases.expected: First and changed wake causes alert even with the old down marker. Recorded pressure or retained conflicts do not cause periodic reannouncement. Separately projected confirmed blockers alert independently, without changing the wake queue or treating a routine check as a user deadline.

cases.description: An overdue workbench goal remains a durable obligation independent of wake admission
cases.setup: An isolated workbench and scheduler with a fake time and an existing scheduled goal due without confirmed handling.
cases.action: Move the check time repeatedly, then exercise a verified blocker, explicit user question, and settled matter.
cases.expected: A routine check stays owed in the workspace without a desktop alert. A real blocker and an unanswered explicit user question remain independently actionable. The notice projection changes no workbench state.
